answer: Mint each new agent one non-transferable entry token struck from a scarce external hardware anchor, like a copper coin from a single die that cannot be stamped in bulk. It locks in a vault that releases reward only after many epochs of peer-audited honest work, and random liveness probes must be answered with an anchor-signed key inside a tight window. Trust accretes slowly like a pearl around one grain, so a sybil farm must fund a distinct anchor per clone and keep each awake to pass its own probe: cost climbs linearly per fake head while an honest node pays once.
